short: Standard: earliest side-by-side CTC/Transformer lip readers on LRS2, one run each; the 70.4% baseline is unconditioned; the online low-latency claim has no measured delay.
position: M06 and M13 changed. M06 standard: BLSTM-CTC, depthwise temporal-convolution CTC and Transformer seq2seq on one front end; none of the 49 earlier sentence-level decoders mentions a Transformer and no confirmed earlier study compares CTC and attention decoders on one front end (Appendix), but each model is trained once on one test set and the comparison mixes objective with beam width and LM weight. M13 not reported: the online FC decoder lags 22 or 32 frames and reproduces the offline output, but no delay or online error rate is measured, unlike Cai et al. 2011 (real-time factors) and Ma et al. 2023 (580 ms, 50.6% streaming WER). M07 standard: the non-public T2 LM gains 0.7-1.3 points. M12 not reported: 70.4% is credited to MV-WAS in Table 1 and to WLAS in Sec. 3.3 with no conditions; the claim holds without T2 (51.2%), but 'over 20' points needs T2; single runs; MV-LRS pretraining is not public.
